infrastructure.name: CFO Cockpit Client-Server Phase — HYOK-Encrypted Hosting + shadcn/ui Front-End Rebuild
infrastructure.notes: BACKLOG 2026-07-04 (CEO+PA architecture/security thread, resolved same day as INI-123's closing note). Realizes the Phase D carve-out INI-123 explicitly deferred: interactivity + write-back requiring a live backend. Architecture = HYOK (Hold-Your-Own-Key): Vercel-hosted app + managed Postgres store the v2 contract as field-level envelope-encrypted records; Clerk auth with mandatory server-side session verification; a key-custody service on the Mac mini reachable only via a narrowly-scoped tunnel holds the master key — ciphertext may live in someone else's cloud, the key never does. CEO also directed the front end be REBUILT on shadcn/ui (Next.js + Tailwind + shadcn component library, shadcn MCP available for build sessions) rather than carried forward as the plain HTML/CSS shell INI-123 ships — this is the first JasonOS surface with a real React build pipeline, adopted deliberately as the go-to pattern for future app-like (not document-like) surfaces. Includes, as a first-class deliverable: a synthetic-data build discipline + credential-revocation/cutover runbook, reusable beyond this build as a JCD client-engagement asset (candidate anonymized case study). FOUNDATION-PREP 2026-07-04: amended to prepare the foundation for INI-126 (CFO Cockpit Planning Mode) — six requirement deltas folded in (§ Planning-Mode foundation requirements): engine-as-callable-service, session-scoped decrypt for the bounded solver, a mutable scenario record type + early write path widening the PCR-FIN-003 amendment, a mini-side export path, a mini-authoritative data-topology constraint, and generator-first composable engine-input machinery. Stale INI-123 'Backlog' sibling refs corrected to Complete.

infrastructure.name: CFO Cockpit Planning Mode — Scenario Modeling (Forward + Bounded-Backward)
infrastructure.notes: BACKLOG 2026-07-04 (CEO+PA inception, immediately after the Planning-Mode requirements definition pass). The interactive scenario capability INI-123 stubbed as '(coming soon)' and carved out as Phase D. Full requirements spec: knowledge/jasonos-vault/finance/planning-mode-requirements.md (Class C). CAPABILITY = define a scenario → evaluate → discard OR operationalize (append the decision queue + write a Cowork handoff brief; the app stages and writes materials, the President Agent drafts the plan in Cowork — the app never authors the plan). Two SEGREGATED modes sharing the engine: FORWARD ('what happens by date Y if I set levers X?', call-once) and BACKWARD, a BOUNDED solver — solve-for-date (forward + threshold detection, call-once) and solve-for-magnitude (fix target+date, ONE free action-lever, 1-D bisection, call-loop ~20-40 evals). Hard rail: exactly ONE free variable per query, ENFORCED not warned (a point answer, never a curve); a second variable is a separate exercise the app supports via CLONE. Non-monotonic RESULT CONTRACT (reached?, first-crossing, sustained-through-horizon?, revert date, not-reached) with absorbing-vs-oscillating metric classification + a target durability qualifier. THREE-TIER composable lever taxonomy (composable parts → primitives [the closed engine hypothetical-input contract] → composite templates, in scope v1) on an orthogonal action/assumption axis; posture is a composite macro, not a primitive; Planning Mode overlays hypotheticals on the model, never edits it. DEPENDS ON INI-124 delivering the foundation (engine-as-callable-service, session-scoped decrypt, scenario record type + write path, mini-side export) — the six requirement deltas are folded into INI-124 as of this filing. Sequenced AFTER INI-124.

infrastructure.name: Environment-Portability Completion — Connector-Layer Portability + Cowork-Coupling Drift Sweep
infrastructure.notes: BACKLOG 2026-07-05 — CEO-directed inception (strategic thread following INI-125 close). Completes the environment-portability program INI-125 advanced: the governance/state layer is now fully portable (any CEO-approved agent, any JasonOS host); this initiative extends the SAME relocate-the-resource pattern to the connector layer (Phase B, item 2) so the only Cowork-tied jobs are Cowork-by-nature (presentation/interaction), not accidents of where a credential happens to live — and reconciles the written record to the new reality (Phase A, item 4, the drift sweep). Guiding test (from the INI-125 retro discussion): a job is environment-bound iff it depends on a resource that exists in only one environment; the fix is always to relocate that resource to a shared substrate and repoint the consumer. Deliberately excludes the presentation/interaction layer, which stays Cowork-only BY DESIGN. Bounded, not program-scale: Phase B provisions the connectors JasonOS operationally depends on (Gmail + Drive path), classifies the rest, and parks broad per-connector provisioning as on-demand follow-ons.
